jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Lead

In Brief

We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. As our Product Marketing Lead, you will own how we show up for health system leaders. That covers the sales content that moves deals forward, the messaging behind each new module, and the story we tell customers who are ready to grow with us.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes.

About the Role

This role spans three connected areas of product marketing: sales enablement, module marketing, and customer expansion. You will own all three end to end. Most of your energy will go to enablement, expansion, and module marketing, in that order of urgency as the field and our roadmap demand.

Product marketing is a function we are still building. You will be our dedicated product marketer, so you will set the standards, templates, and systems as much as you follow them. You will decide what gets built next based on what Sales and Client Success tell you is moving deals and renewals. As the team grows, you may have the chance to mentor more junior marketers.

What You'll Own

Sales Enablement

Own the core sales content library, including the sales deck, two-pagers, white papers, and collateral that quantify our impact for buyers and customers. Keep it accurate and current as the product and the market change. Work with Sales to learn which pieces move deals forward and which ones don't.

Deal-Specific Content

Build tailored content for late-stage opportunities, such as custom one-pagers and slides. Take a rough brief from a sales rep and return a polished deliverable without a heavy process around you. Be able to point to specific content you built that helped advance or close a deal.

Competitive Intelligence

Maintain competitive intel and battlecards as the market shifts. Keep them current without being asked, so reps never walk into a conversation with outdated information.

Product and Module Marketing

Develop positioning and messaging by module and buyer. Build module deep-dive materials and lead go-to-market for module launches, including palliative care and deterioration.

Customer Expansion

Partner with Client Success on expansion messaging, executive steering committee and QBR materials, and release communications for existing customers. Help customers see the value they are already getting and what more is possible.

Buyer Messaging

Write for the full health system buying committee, including CMOs, CMIOs, CIOs, CFOs, and quality leaders. Translate clinical outcomes and technical capabilities into language that resonates with clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders. Make a business case land with a C-suite, not just a product pitch.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Join deal calls and QBRs. Pull roadmap details from Product proactively, and work with Clinical to keep every claim credible. Surface what is working in the field and feed market and competitive insight back into the business.

What You'll Bring

•
5+ years of product marketing experience in healthcare technology, with direct experience marketing to health system executive buyers

•
A bachelor's degree

•
A record of building positioning, messaging, enablement, and launch programs that sales teams actually use

•
A track record of deal-specific content tied to advanced or closed opportunities

•
Experience writing for CMOs, CMIOs, CIOs, CFOs, and quality leaders, and supporting long, multi-stakeholder deals into health systems

•
Working knowledge of how enterprise health system deals move, including committee-based buying, clinical validation, IT and security review, and budget cycles

•
Exceptional writing that is clear, credible, and evidence-based, with first drafts that need little rework

•
Self-direction in a fast-moving startup, including the instinct to spot what is missing and build it without being asked

•
Strong partnership habits with Sales, Product, Client Success, and Clinical teams

Nice to Haves

•
Product or customer marketing experience with an installed base, including expansion or upsell campaigns

•
Familiarity with clinical AI, clinical decision support, or quality and safety improvement

•
Experience informally mentoring a more junior marketer

Life at Bayesian

We're a small, mission-driven team building AI tools that help clinicians catch life-threatening conditions earlier. We work remotely but stay closely connected in real time. We believe that closer collaboration helps us move faster for the hospitals and patients who depend on us.

Our values guide how we work every day:

•
Patients at the center. We hold ourselves to a high bar for excellence and impact.

•
Hard problems, real breakthroughs. We pursue new ideas even when it's uncomfortable.

•
No surprises, clear signals. We communicate clearly and honestly, so teams and customers can trust us.

•
Whole people, shared respect. We treat teammates with respect and make space to grow.

•
Truth seekers, stronger together. We debate openly and align around shared goals.

What We Offer

•
Medical, Dental & Vision: Coverage through Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, including an HSA-eligible option, plus dental and vision through Guardian/VSP. Bayesian covers the majority of your premium and a meaningful share of your dependents' coverage. Enrolled members also get access to One Medical for same-day and 24/7 virtual primary care.

•
Life & Disability: Life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability, fully company-paid.

•
401(k): A company retirement plan with your choice of investment approach.

•
Wellbeing: Free mental health support through Spring Health, plus additional wellness resources including pet care benefits and more.

•
Time Off: Generous PTO that grows with tenure, paid sick time, paid holidays, and occasional company-wide self-care days.

•
Equity: You'll also receive equity, so you share directly in what we build together.

•
Team Retreats: A fully paid annual company retreat to connect with the team in person.

•
Equipment: Your choice of Mac hardware, a one-time home office stipend, and ongoing reimbursement for internet and phone costs.

Team: Marketing

Reports to: Head of Marketing

Level: Senior individual contributor

Employment Classification: Full-Time with Benefits

Salary: $160,000 - $180,000

Candidates based in certain high-cost cities may be eligible for a geographic premium.

Bayesian Health is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals, including for disability, pregnancy-related conditions, and religious practice. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, contact careers@bayesianhealth.com.

jobs.title: German-speaking Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
This role is part of our Central Marketing Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don't forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

At saas.group paid acquisition across our portfolio runs through a small network of experienced PPC freelancers. We're looking for a German-speaking Performance Marketing Lead to oversee this: someone who owns the standards, strategy and quality bar for paid across our portfolio, from accounts ranging from small to large monthly budgets. The role goes beyond people-management, with continued hands-on responsibilities. You'll set the systems and direction and lead the freelancer network, but you'll also be in the accounts yourself on the most valuable brands, and you'll be the person we trust to judge whether the work being done is actually good. If you want real ownership of a function where your work impacts 25+ brands, this is that role.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

• Take ownership of our most valuable paid accounts and demonstrably move performance, while keeping smaller-budget accounts efficient.

• Set a consistent standard across all brand accounts: how campaigns are structured, how conversions are tracked, how performance is reported, so there's a consistent quality bar across the whole portfolio.

• Take over the paid accounts of a newly acquired brand cleanly: audit, tracking check and handover with no performance dip.

Your responsibilities

• Own paid performance strategy and standards across the portfolio, and run the most valuable accounts hands-on yourself (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn, and others), including ad copy and landing page testing.

• Lead and support our PPC freelancers: set targets, review accounts, approve budgets, run regular syncs, challenge the "why" behind decisions, and keep the rest of marketing in the loop.

• Advise brands directly on strategy and budget allocation, with the ability to push back, manage expectations and tell a brand honestly when a channel or budget won't deliver.

• Take over newly acquired brands' paid setups and build the systems, documentation and reporting that let performance scale across more brands and freelancers without losing the quality bar.

• Partner closely with our data analytics team on tracking, attribution and the flow of CRM data back into the ad platforms, and support the M&A team on due diligence for paid-heavy acquisition targets.

• Regularly connect with the SEO Team Lead to remain aligned with campaigns and strategies.

What you bring to the table

• Several years owning paid budgets (think €1M+ a year) while staying genuinely hands-on: you can open an account, diagnose it and run the full campaign yourself.

• Demonstrated B2B lead-gen experience on search: comfortable with low conversion volumes, long sales cycles and optimising for lead quality over click counts (B2B SaaS, B2B or adjacent backgrounds such as gaming portfolios are welcome, as long as you can translate them to B2B).

• A track record across very different budget sizes, from a few thousand a month to six figures a month, making small budgets work through sharp targeting and prioritisation rather than leaning on automated bidding.

• Deep Google Ads and Microsoft Ads expertise, strong LinkedIn Ads experience, and the curiosity to pick up new platforms as brands need them. You're also confident with the measurement stack behind paid: GA4, Google Tag Manager, offline conversion imports and CRM integration. Experience with ChatGPT ads is a bonus.

• German at C1 or native: strong enough to write compelling German ad copy, alongside fluent English.

• Genuine AI fluency, and the drive to put it to work. You already use AI tools (Claude especially) in your day-to-day, and you're the kind of person who looks for where they can sharpen paid performance, from research and analysis to campaign and reporting workflows.

What's in it for you

• Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

• Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way - with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

• Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

• Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

• Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

• Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.

How You'll Win at Hadley Designs

You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.

• Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.

• Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.

• Clear, confident spoken and written English

• Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it

This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.

Benefits

• Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins

• Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO

Marketing & Content Intern (Part-Time)

Remote (US)

About Kinelo

Kinelo is an early-stage AI startup building technology that helps companies work faster by keeping company knowledge current and making it available to both people and AI. Our proactive AI Coworkers use that knowledge to take on work, coordinate across teams, and keep people informed.

We're looking for a marketing intern to help us build and grow Kinelo's presence in the market. The role covers a wide range of marketing activities, from content, social media, and creative production to market research, partnerships, and campaigns.

You'll work directly with our founding GTM lead and have plenty of opportunities to come up with ideas and execute them.

On a given day or week, you might

• Come up with content ideas for X, LinkedIn, and other channels, then help turn those ideas into posts, articles, videos, or visual content.

• Develop creative video concepts, plan and edit short-form videos, and experiment with different styles and formats.

• Design graphics, social assets, and other visuals for our website, content, and marketing campaigns.

• Research AI trends, competitors, and relevant industry conversations to identify interesting topics, market opportunities, and new ideas worth exploring.

• Find relevant creators, influencers, newsletters, and communities, research their audiences, and help coordinate potential collaborations.

• Support marketing campaigns, from researching target audiences and developing content to coordinating distribution and tracking results.

• Help create website content, customer stories, presentations, and other marketing materials.

• Research journalists, podcasts, events, and other opportunities to get Kinelo in front of relevant audiences.

• Experiment with different marketing ideas, see what works, and bring recommendations for what we should try next.

We're looking for someone who

• Is currently studying marketing, communications, journalism, media, or a related field.

• Has previous marketing/content internship experience OR has built and managed their own social media accounts.

• Writes well and has a good instinct for what makes content interesting, useful, or worth sharing.

• Has experience creating and editing videos, especially short-form content, and is comfortable developing creative concepts from scratch.

• Has a good eye for visual design and experience with tools like Canva, Figma, CapCut, Adobe, or similar.

• Understands social media platforms, follows relevant creators and trends, and has opinions about what makes good content.

• Is a strong researcher who can dig into unfamiliar topics, find useful information, and turn it into ideas or recommendations.

• Is actively using AI tools in their own work, studies, or creative projects, and enjoys experimenting with new tools and finding ways to get better results. You don't need a technical background, but you should be excited about what AI makes possible.

• Is resourceful, organized, and comfortable figuring things out independently.

Logistics

• Part-time, approximately 10-20 hours per week

• $25/hr

• Remote (US)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kinelo-marketing-content-intern-part-time

Headquarters: La Canada Flintridge, California, United States

Work model: Remote
Expected compensation : Base salary starting at $85,000 CAD per annum
Vacancy status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.

About AudienceView
AudienceView is passionate about helping live event organizations bring people together through unforgettable experiences. Our unified event commerce platform helps organizations better understand, engage, and grow their audiences while creating stronger relationships and more connected experiences across the entire event journey.
We support organizations across performing arts, music, athletics, higher education, fairs, festivals, attractions, and more. By combining technology, audience intelligence, and deep industry expertise, AudienceView helps organizations make informed decisions, simplify operations, and build sustainable growth.

Four core values set the tempo for how we work:

• We are people first.

• We are innovative.

• We are results-driven.

• We are transparent.

AudienceView is made up of people who believe wholeheartedly in the power and magic of live events. Come transform live entertainment with us.

Why we'd want to work with you
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this role, you will drive pipeline growth and lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) by orchestrating high-impact paid campaigns, targeted ABM programs, and sophisticated marketing automation workflows. If you are a data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between paid media, email nurtures, and sales execution, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

• Paid Search & Paid Ads: Own Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end—including strategy, budgeting, bidding, keyword research, audience building, and creative testing—to drive pipeline and optimize CAC. Expand into review platforms (G2, Capterra) where it makes strategic sense.

• Email Marketing & Nurture: Design and execute email programs in Pardot, focusing on precise segmentation, multi-touch nurture tracks, trigger-based sends, and lifecycle campaigns tailored to key buyer personas.

• Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Own the tooling, account scoring, and 1-to-many ABM framework. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to build tiered target account lists and deliver personalized, programmatic campaigns.

• Marketing Automation & CRO: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot workflows, lead scoring models, and routing rules to ensure leads reach Sales quickly and accurately. Improve website conversion rates through landing pages, form optimization, and CRO experiments.

• Reporting & Attribution: Track performance across paid, email, ABM, and automation. Report on spend, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and CAC by channel to guide data-driven budget allocation.

• Test & Optimize: Continually run experiments across channels, messaging, and funnel paths to scale what works and cut what doesn't.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, BDRs, RevOps, and Product Marketing to ensure airtight alignment on targeting, messaging, and lead handoffs.

What you'll need:

• 4+ years of B2B digital demand generation experience , with a proven track record of scaling inbound pipeline.

• Paid Media Expertise: Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads with a focus on efficiency (CAC) and revenue generation.

• Marketing Automation: Strong command of Pardot (or similar enterprise automation tools), email compliance, segmentation, and lead-scoring frameworks.

• Technical Stack: Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Analytics / GA4, and WordPress (or equivalent CMS).

• Analytical Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a deep understanding of marketing attribution models and funnel metrics.

• Project Management: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing and Sales teams.

• Mindset: A curious, self-starting operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves continuous learning.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

• High-Intent MQLs: Volume and lead quality by channel and segment.

• Marketing-Generated Pipeline: Total opportunity value created.

• Pipeline Velocity & Conversion Rates: Website, funnel, nurture, and trial-to-paid conversion performance.

• Engagement & Progression: Email engagement metrics and target account movement through the ABM funnel.

Few people tick every box on a list like this. If most of it sounds like you and the rest sounds like something you'd love to learn, we still want to hear from you.

Why work at AudienceView

• Our work helps bring live experiences to life. From Broadway tours and symphony performances to music festivals, museums, universities, attractions, and community events, our software helps organizations of all sizes connect people with unforgettable experiences every day.

• We're fans, not just vendors. Our teams include former box office staff, front-of-house crew, local musicians, season ticket holders, arts advocates, and lifelong eventgoers. That shared passion for live experiences is at the heart of everything we do.

• You'll solve meaningful challenges at scale. Supporting over 2800 organizations and millions of ticket buyers means working on complex, rewarding problems. Whether it's powering major on-sales, improving the patron experience, or helping clients grow their audiences, you'll see the impact of your work firsthand.

• We're remote-first with a live-events heart. Work alongside globally based colleagues who share a genuine passion for the arts, culture, sports, entertainment, and live experiences that bring people together.

• Diversity and inclusion are paramount to building our culture. The data is abundantly clear that diverse teams are more successful because they offer different perspectives, increased innovation, faster problem-solving and higher employee engagement among other benefits.

How we hire — our run of show
No black holes and no endless rounds. Here's the run of show, so you know exactly what's coming and when:

• Screening & Resume Review: Our Talent Acquisition team will evaluate all resumes and select candidates for a video screening call for 30 minutes.

• Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager to speak in detail about your relevant experience and learn more about the role.

• Meet More of the Team (60 minutes): Meet more team members to learn more about the work culture and expectations.

• Case Study Interview (45 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager again to complete a quick case study.

Every interview is held face to face over Microsoft Teams with a member of our team on camera. If we interview you, we will tell you whether a hiring decision has been made for this role within 45 days of your last interview.

How we use artificial intelligence in hiring
We use AI in one place only. Our hiring team may use Microsoft Copilot to transcribe interviews and draft interview notes, so that interviewers can concentrate on the conversation instead of typing. You will always know before any recording or AI note-taking begins, and you can ask us to take notes manually instead — it will not affect your application.
We do not use AI to screen, assess, rank or select applicants, and no automated system makes a hiring decision at any stage. Every shortlisting, interview and offer decision is made by people on our hiring team.

Equal opportunity, inclusion and accessibility
Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at AudienceView. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our clients, the communities where we operate, and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified people of every background.
We are committed to an accessible hiring process and provide accommodations and adjustments to applicants with disabilities on request, at every stage of recruitment and employment.

How to spot a genuine AudienceView offer
AudienceView does not offer employment to anyone without first ensuring that qualified candidates speak directly with a member of the hiring team. All qualifying conversations take place face to face over Microsoft Teams. We do not make offers of employment without meeting candidates, we never make an offer by text message, and we never ask candidates to pay a fee. If you are asked for personal or financial information by text, or before you have met a member of our hiring team, please disregard it.

Ready to join the show?
If this role sounds like your kind of show and your experience lines up with what we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. We’re grateful for every application we receive; however, only qualified candidates selected to move forward in our hiring process will be contacted.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/audienceview-digital-marketing-manager

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Firefox Enterprise
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla ?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We’re building a new B2B business for Firefox— bringing a privacy-first, data-safe browser and productivity bundle to European organizations. As we grow our EU-based demand generation team ahead of our Q1 2027 bundle launch, we’re looking for an experienced Field Marketing Manager for France based in France. You will independently own the regional field plan, budget and senior Sales partnership for the France region and broader EU enterprise market. You will turn named-account priorities into a focused portfolio of high-value executive and technical experiences, with particular attention to French-language delivery, local enterprise buying dynamics, and the needs of complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You’ll work closely with Sales, Channel, Product Marketing, and Content teams to bring our go-to-market strategy to life on the ground, and you’ll help build the processes and playbooks this team relies on as it scales from a small pilot into a full regional function. This is a hands-on senior role for a marketer who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: selecting the few moments that matter, orchestrating cross-functional and agency support, and ensuring each program creates a clear next step for a priority account

What you'll do:

• Co-create the quarterly France and EU market field plan with Sales, translating selected accounts, account stage and stakeholder priorities into a sequenced engagement plan.

• Design and run a small portfolio of high-touch programs, including executive roundtables, private briefings, technical workshops, pilot-readiness sessions and a deliberately selected set of industry events.

• Define the intended account outcome for every program: the target stakeholders, the desired meeting or next step, the pre-event engagement plan, the seller handoff and the follow-up assets required.

• Own the France and EU market field budget, agency and vendor relationships, timelines, risk and execution quality; use shared Mozilla teams and the European agency for production, localization, PR, web and media operations.

• Create and localize program narratives and assets into French in partnership with Product Marketing and Content, ensuring relevance for enterprise IT, security, privacy, procurement and business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Product Marketing, Analyst Relations, Content/Creative, and Demand Gen colleagues to keep messaging consistent across the channel mix.

• Develop locally relevant programs and assets with Product, Security and Solutions partners, who retain ownership of technical accuracy and validation.

• Bring the voice of the French and EU market back to the team, including buyer concerns, competitor signals, account feedback and regional ecosystem insight; convert learning into better messaging, field playbooks and return-on-event decisions.

• Build repeatable field operating rhythms and reporting, contribute to the 2027 launch and customer-proof plan, and create learning that supports 2028 European expansion.

• Track and report on program performance, using pipeline and engagement data to refine regional tactics.

How Success will be measured:

• Priority accounts progress to an agreed commercial, executive or technical next step.

• The right stakeholders attend and engage; success is based on account quality and coverage, not attendee volume.

• Sales accepts the handoff, completes follow-up and can see how each program contributed to account movement.

• Executive meetings, technical workshops, pilot activity and procurement support increase in the selected account set.

• Reusable French-language proof, playbooks and market insight are created on time and used by the team.

• Programs meet quality, budget and operational commitments.

What you’ll bring:

• 5+ years of experience in field marketing, account-based marketing, enterprise events or regional go-to-market for B2B software, security or IT-managed products.

• Demonstrated ability to independently own a country or regional plan, budget, vendors and senior Sales relationships.

• French native, fluent in English; German language skills preferred. Experience across the French market.

• Strong understanding of complex enterprise buying groups, including IT, security, privacy, procurement and works council stakeholders.

• Experience designing high-touch programs for named accounts and translating event activity into specific seller next steps.

• Excellent project, agency and vendor management skills, with strong judgment about where to invest and what not to do.

• A data-informed approach that combines program signals with account-level feedback and commercial context.

• Comfort operating in an early-stage environment with ambiguity, high ownership and regular regional travel.

• Excellent collaboration skills across marketing, sales, and cross-functional partners.

What you’ll get:

• Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team

• Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

• Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together

• Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

• One-time home office stipend

• Annual professional development budget

• Quarterly well-being stipend

• Considerable paid parental leave

• Employee referral bonus program

• Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

jobs.title: Copywriter (Performance) - 12 month contract
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

We’re a purpose-driven brand with big goals. We don’t just want to succeed – we want to make the world a better place while we do it. But here’s the challenge: we need someone who can craft compelling content that not only drives performance and boosts conversions, but also stays true to our brand and our humanity. It’s a true writer’s challenge, and we need you to help us hit it out of the park. If you’re a performance copywriter who believes in the power of words to create both impact and results, we’d love you to join our team.

Reporting to the Senior Copywriter, you’ll collaborate closely with our creative team to create paid video campaigns, SEO-focussed blog posts and search-optimised Meta content that fuels both our growth and our social impact. From concepting and scripting videos with our talented video team to crafting copy that aligns with our brand and performance objectives, your words will help drive both visibility and results. Plus, your SEO-driven blog posts will help boost rankings and extend our reach.

This role is fully remote based in our Australian hub and is a 12-month fixed term contract.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

• Worked closely with the video team to develop a fresh concept and script for our Meta videos, featuring a playful showdown between our co-founders as they debate their favourite Who Gives A Crap product, optimised for conversion and engagement.

• Crafted a cheeky blog post that reveals what it means if you scrunch or fold your toilet paper, designed to grab attention and spark conversation.

• Brainstormed ways we can make our impact messaging more resonant and sticky.

• Worked with the Digital Product team on elevating our site experience with A/B testing.

• Written a direct mail insert to encourage people to share our brand with friends.

• Joined our monthly Creative Pin Ups and helped celebrate the team’s work.

• Brainstormed and shared inspiration in the monthly Copy team meeting.

• Joined one of our Creative Team squads to help contribute to the culture of the team.

Let’s talk about you

Performance copywriting is your bread and butter

You’ve honed your performance copywriting skills, excelling at crafting scripts and supporting copy for paid video ads across multiple channels. SEO and social media ad platform experience are essential, but we’re happy to help you build expertise if you have a hunger for learning. Conceptual experience isn’t a must – what’s important is your grasp of our tone of voice and how it comes to life beyond the page. You tailor content for each platform, making sure it’s engaging, on brand and optimised for performance, blending creativity with data-driven insights to drive results.

You’re curious and strategically aware

You ask insightful questions and make sure your work is aligned with marketing strategies and broader business goals. You’ve consistently applied performance marketing best practice across various channels, and you stay up to date with trends and principles so your copy drives results.

You’re self-aware and collaborative

You build strong, positive relationships with your manager, the creative team and cross-functional partners. You know how to work in highly collaborative environments and you’re good at balancing e-commerce goals with tone of voice and creative excellence. Your self-awareness and ability to adapt to different perspectives keep you aligned with business objectives while making teamwork feel seamless.

You’re a time management guru

You thrive in fast-paced environments and manage your time efficiently. With multiple channels to track and new work constantly coming in, you excel under pressure, meeting deadlines and prioritising key tasks. You proactively flag challenges to your manager or project manager, keeping the workflow smooth and the team on track. Your ability to juggle competing priorities is crucial to driving our business objectives and performance goals.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Release Marketer
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia , and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby .

I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I’ve worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum with whom I’d spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. I joined Ashby in April of 2024 back in Product Marketing - bringing all these experiences together to help build a thoughtful, high-impact team.

We’re a growing, tight-knit team - and we’re just getting started 🚀 We work closely with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and every level of leadership, including closely with our CEO Benji . We’re seen as strategic partners, not a service desk. PMM at Ashby means influence, visibility, and ownership - and this role is a chance to get in early on a team with strong internal momentum at a company growing fast.

We value technical curiosity, editorial clarity, and first-principles thinking. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and aim to genuinely help customers understand what our product does and how it can help them. You don’t need a decade in PMM to succeed here - but you do need strong product instincts, clear writing, and a bias for building systems that scale.

We’re looking for a Release Marketer who is excited about owning product releases.

This role is for someone who thrives on the details but understands the bigger picture – someone who can clearly explain how a new feature or product benefits prospects and customers in their daily workflows and approach to talent acquisition. Someone who wants to work closely with Product and Engineering to understand how a feature works, and act as a translator for the front-line teams. That means translating product specs into the materials, messaging, and demos that power our releases. This person should feel excited about selling with value and obsess over customer use cases and how we tell our product story. From crafting one-pagers and recording crisp, clear product videos and walkthroughs, to running our product updates newsletter, to building internal enablement that keeps our whole team informed on what’s changed, you’ll help us tell our differentiated story and keep our launch velocity high.

You’ll work across multiple product lines, so you’ll need to context switch easily. Organization, attention to detail, and the ability to juggle and coordinate across multiple teams are among the most important skills for this role. On any given week, you’ll be keeping several releases moving, each with its own Product Manager.

Because we’ve built deep relationships with a thoughtful, engaged customer base, we’re often co-creating with them - sharing product materials that are actually read, used, and appreciated by people who see us as partners, not just vendors.

This is a great fit for someone who enjoys being in the weeds of technical products, but also has a sharp editorial voice, a strong eye for design, strong product instincts, and loves to always be shipping.

While this role will flex across multiple products, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into eventually owning a full product line. This role is also a great opportunity for someone who wants to flex across PMM and enablement skills, and work on product marketing initiatives that create more leverage for our teams.

Your Background

There is not a single background that is the perfect fit for this role. We care more about the skills and intrinsic capabilities you bring to the table, and could see someone from a number of different backgrounds being a good fit, including:

•
A Solutions Engineer who loves narrative and wants to shape more than just demos

•
An Early-stage AE who worked closely with Product

•
A Product-minded builder with a technical background and customer empathy

•
A GTM specialist with a strong lean for product taste

What You’ll Do

Release Products and Features

•
Own go-to-market planning and execution for feature releases across multiple product lines.

•
Work closely with Product Managers to shape value propositions, messaging, and demo strategies.

•
Produce polished feature videos for use across social media, the website, and other marketing channels.

•
Create assets including blog posts, one-pagers, demo videos, internal launch docs, and enablement materials.

•
Turn features into clear customer value through videos, product walkthroughs, and content that make the benefit obvious.

•
Partner with other product marketers on larger and bundled launches where support is needed.

Keep the release engine moving and create leverage for your team

•
Serve as a product expert and go-to resource for how features work and how we position to the market.

•
Coordinate release promotion with Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Sales, CS & Support teams to ensure audiences across the organization are best-equipped through their channels.

•
Own initiatives that keep the whole team informed on product changes, including our product updates newsletter to customers.

•
Help maintain our product launch velocity by leveraging AI, automation, and building scalable systems to manage a high volume of releases, giving yourself time back for more high-leverage work.

You Might Be a Fit If You

•
You’re highly organized, and can keep multiple releases, owners, and deadlines moving at once without anything slipping.

•
You’ve got an exceptional eye for detail - people consistently trust you as the final eye on something because you catch more than just typos every time .

•
You can switch between products and contexts easily, and pick up a new feature quickly enough to explain it well.

•
You’re the person people ping and say, “Can you just explain this feature in normal words?” and you actually can.

•
You know how to shape a good demo or walkthrough that tells a story. Not just “click here, then here” but “here’s how this solves your problem.”

•
You are comfortable owning your own copy and collaborating with design teams to produce well-polished assets.

•
You can read a launch plan and immediately hear the voices of Sales and CS in your head “but what about XYZ?”, and you’ve already worked with technical and product teams for the answer.

•
You can follow a playbook but are not afraid to go back to first principles thinking and build something from scratch without much direction.

You Might Not Be a Fit If:

•
You’re drained by the strive for perfection. If a letter is out of place or a font is off by a size point, it won’t bother you.

•
You’re not a natural relationship builder and don’t feel comfortable working across Product and GTM folks.

•
You aren’t the person people go to when they’re trying to understand the complexities of a new product.

•
You find stakeholder and project management more draining than satisfying.

•
You’d rather not weigh in on or be the final call on creative because someone else will catch it (noting you will have design support, but that someone to catch it is you :)

Interview Plan:

•
30 min with Michelle (Recruiting)

•
45 min Rosalia (Hiring Manager)

•
30 min with Harriet (VP of Marketing)

•
Assignment

•
30 min with Benji (CEO and Co-founder)

jobs.title: Growth Marketer, SEO/AEO and Experimentation
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview:

Search is changing. Enterprise buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews which Customer Experience AI platforms to evaluate, often before they ever visit a vendor’s website. Your job is to make sure Cresta shows up in those answers, shows up accurately, and turns that visibility into pipeline.

You’ll join Cresta’s Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Growth Marketing and working alongside our Content Marketing Manager on a small team that treats organic search and AI discovery as a core pipeline channel.

You will own day-to-day execution of Cresta’s Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and SEO program. Roughly 70 to 80 percent of your time goes to scaling organic search and AI visibility. The rest goes to growth experiments on new acquisition channels and conversion levers.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You will run the systems that make Cresta’s organic engine work: the AI content workflows, the technical foundation, the measurement, and the testing roadmap. The Content Marketing Manager leads writing; you own how that content gets found, cited, and converted. You will also work with web development, product marketing, demand generation, and revenue operations, and report results straight to marketing leadership.

What you'll do

AEO and organic search

• Grow Cresta's visibility, citation share, and narrative accuracy across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews through content structure, schema, entity consistency, and third-party mentions.

• Own our AirOps workflows for content briefs, refreshes, and optimization, and keep improving them so a small team ships more without lowering the bar.

• Run the content refresh pipeline: spot decaying pages in Google Search Console and Ahrefs, diagnose the cause, and partner with the Content Marketing Manager to brief and ship fixes.

• Restructure high-impression pages for AI answers: answer-first sections, self-contained answer passages, FAQ and list schema, and clear relationships between products, use cases, and industries.

• Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, and site architecture. Work directly in our Webflow CMS to ship fixes, and partner with web development on larger changes.

• Build an off-site presence program across review platforms, analyst and industry directories, third-party roundups, partner pages, and communities where answer engines source their information.

• Make sure every product launch and rename gets organic coverage from day one, working with product marketing on URLs, redirects, schema, and answer content.

• Turn questions from sales calls, support conversations, community threads, and search data into a prioritized answer backlog written in the buyer's own language.

Growth experimentation

• Design, launch, and read out experiments on emerging acquisition channels, such as community and Reddit, and on landing page and website conversion from organic traffic.

• Write a hypothesis and success metric before every test launches, then make a clear call to scale it or kill it.

Measurement and reporting

• Own measurement across non-branded visibility, organic and AI-referred traffic, AI citations and share of voice, and influenced pipeline.

• Build dashboards that catch ranking drops, indexing issues, crawl anomalies, and technical regressions before they cost us traffic.

• Connect search and answer engine visibility to pipeline in HubSpot, and keep measured data and modeled estimates clearly separated.

• Stay ahead of changes in search and AI discovery, and turn them into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap.

What success looks like

• First 90 days: You own the content refresh pipeline and AirOps workflows end to end, have shipped your first round of answer-first page rebuilds, and run a recurring AI visibility report that leadership reads.

• First 6 months: You run the AEO testing roadmap independently, have launched at least two growth experiments outside organic search, and can show which pages and channels are driving pipeline.

• First 12 months: You are the go-to person for how Cresta shows up in AI answers, and the program you run is a repeatable, measurable growth channel.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, please apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. If you are coming from an adjacent team and have been teaching yourself AEO on the side, we want to hear from you.

Minimum requirements

• 3 to 5 years of experience in SEO, growth marketing, or other organic growth roles, with hands-on ownership of a live website.

• A track record of growing organic traffic and pipeline or signups, not just rankings.

• Hands-on experience with AEO or GEO, including how AI assistants retrieve, summarize, and cite content, plus at least one project or test you can walk us through, including self-directed ones.

• Technical SEO fluency and comfort shipping changes yourself: HTML basics, schema markup, and working inside a CMS.

• Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, and GA4, plus an AI visibility tool such as Ahrefs Brand Radar or Profound.

• Experience defining metrics, building dashboards, and using data to prioritize work, including reconciling conflicting sources and forming your own conclusion.

• Clear, precise writing. You can write a brief a writer can execute without a follow-up meeting, and an answer passage an LLM can quote.

• A high bar for quality and full ownership from idea through implementation and measurement.

Preferred qualifications

• In-house SEO or growth experience at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion or a technically complex product.

• Experience with AirOps or building content workflows with LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT.

• Experience with Webflow, HubSpot, or multi-touch attribution.

• Experience with crawl and log analysis tools, programmatic pages, or scaled content operations.

• SQL or Python skills for pulling and analyzing data on your own.

• Experience running conversion rate or community channel experiments, including Reddit.

• Exposure to customer experience, customer support, or contact center operations.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family

• Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

• Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child

• Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future

• Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office

• Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

• In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Harriet, and I lead Marketing at Ashby .

We've built a business with 5,500+ customers, a highly differentiated product, and a brand that people genuinely care about. We've invested in content, customer stories, community, and the foundations of a strong marketing program. Now, we have an opportunity to build a much bigger paid engine to support our next stage of growth.

We're looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Manager to build it.

You'll take ownership of our existing LinkedIn program and expand across Meta, Google Search, YouTube, and other channels. You'll have meaningful budget, strong creative and technical partners, and the autonomy to build a program that creates qualified pipeline and strengthens our brand.

This is a hands-on role. We want someone who knows their channels inside out, enjoys getting into the details, and can take a campaign from initial hypothesis through execution, analysis, and optimization. You'll have access to specialist support when it makes sense, but you'll be the person driving the work.

We also believe AI creates an opportunity for exceptional individual contributors to do work that previously required much larger teams. We're looking for someone who is already exploring that opportunity and wants to push it further.

What makes this role interesting

You get to build with the resources most marketers wish they had.

Paid is relatively underdeveloped at Ashby compared with the scale of our business. You get to build something substantial without unwinding years of accumulated complexity or fighting for the resources to make it work. We have strong content, customer proof, product differentiation, and an established brand. You'll start with a monthly budget in the hundreds of thousands of dollars and the support of our design, web, and RevOps teams.

You can rethink how paid marketing gets done.

We want to enable exceptional individual contributors to accomplish more through AI, automation, and better workflows. You'll have the freedom to experiment with new tools, build systems that improve your output, and challenge established ways of working.

You'll build a program that makes the brand and business stronger.

We believe great paid marketing combines analytical rigor with creative judgment. You'll optimize for pipeline and efficiency while building campaigns that earn attention, communicate our differentiation, and give the right buyers a reason to care about Ashby. We don't want a lead-generation machine that makes our brand worse.

What you'll own

Build and scale our paid program. Own strategy and execution across LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Search, expanding into YouTube and other channels as opportunities emerge. Prioritize audiences, develop campaign hypotheses, manage budgets, and turn promising experiments into repeatable sources of qualified pipeline.

Drive creative strategy and experimentation. Develop campaign concepts, write ad copy, brief creative, and shape landing-page tests. Work closely with design, content, and product marketing to produce distinctive work. Build a disciplined testing cadence across audiences, creative, offers, and conversion paths, knowing when to scale, iterate, or stop.

Use AI to increase your impact. Build practical workflows using AI, agents, and automation to improve research, creative iteration, campaign operations, and analysis. We want someone who actively experiments with new approaches, evaluates their effectiveness, and turns what works into repeatable systems.

Own measurement and performance. Drive our approach to paid measurement in partnership with RevOps. Establish the signals and reporting needed to understand qualified reach, conversion, pipeline contribution, and efficiency. Develop better ways to assess incrementality, make informed decisions with imperfect attribution, and translate performance data into clear investment recommendations.

Connect campaigns to the buyer journey. Partner with sales, lifecycle, and ABM to understand what makes an opportunity valuable and how paid can influence the journey from first touch through pipeline. Adapt messaging and investment to our customer segments and markets.

What you'll work on in your first six months

•
Take ownership of LinkedIn, identifying opportunities to improve qualified reach, creative, and progression into pipeline.

•
Build and scale Meta, establishing a strong creative testing cadence and the landing pages and follow-up needed to make the channel work.

•
Expand Google Search and launch YouTube, evaluating additional channels where there's a compelling audience and learning opportunity.

•
Establish a stronger operating system for paid, including AI-enabled workflows, measurement, and a clear approach to allocating investment.

The goal isn't to scale every channel equally. It's to build a broad set of opportunities, learn quickly, and concentrate investment where the evidence is strongest.

What we're looking for

We care more about what you've built and how you think than the number of years you've spent in marketing.

•
You're a domain expert in paid media. You have deep, hands-on expertise in LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Ads. You understand the platforms, know how to structure and optimize campaigns, and can explain how your decisions have influenced qualified pipeline. You've personally built and scaled programs in sales-led B2B SaaS.

•
You're a builder, not just a strategist. You're excited to get into the accounts, develop the creative, run experiments, investigate performance, and solve problems yourself. You know when external expertise can help, but you don't need an agency to do the core work.

•
You combine analytical rigor with creative taste. You understand performance metrics and experimentation, but you also know what makes advertising compelling. You can connect campaign decisions to buyer quality and pipeline without losing sight of the brand you're building.

•
You're already changing how you work with AI. You can demonstrate how you've used AI tools, agents, or automation to improve your output. You think critically about where automation helps, how to evaluate its results, and how to turn useful experiments into repeatable workflows.

•
You take ownership of measurement. You can work with CRM data, establish useful performance reporting, investigate attribution limitations, and drive better measurement approaches rather than waiting for someone else to provide the answers. You own budgeting and explain the case for reallocating investment.

•
You're a strong cross-functional partner. You work well with sales, design, content, product marketing, and RevOps. You seek out context, share what you learn, and care about the overall customer experience rather than optimizing your own channel in isolation.

Experience with YouTube, display, and programmatic is valuable, as is familiarity with HubSpot and measurement platforms like Dreamdata. You don't need to have mastered every channel, but you should have the expertise and judgment to expand beyond your core strengths.

This isn't the right role for you if

•
You prefer managing agencies to building campaigns. You want to set the strategy and have other people execute it, rather than getting into the details yourself.

•
You measure success primarily through platform metrics. You're satisfied with lower CPCs or more leads without understanding whether you're reaching the right buyers or contributing to pipeline.

•
You treat brand and performance as separate disciplines. You optimize individual campaigns without considering how the work shapes a prospect's perception of Ashby or contributes to long-term demand.

•
You haven't meaningfully changed how you work with AI. You're interested in the topic but haven't experimented with workflows, tools, or automation that improve your output.

•
You rely on other people to supply the ideas. You need a content team to hand you finished assets, a creative team to develop every concept, or an agency to tell you what to test next.

•
You prefer a proven playbook to an open-ended problem. You'd rather repeat an established formula than question assumptions, explore new opportunities, and work out what makes sense for this business.

•
You optimize your channel at the expense of the bigger picture. You don't enjoy collaborating with other teams or taking responsibility for the experience beyond the ad click.

We want someone who takes real pride in their craft, is generous with their expertise, and is excited to build something that the whole team can be proud of.

The tools you'll work with

Our core stack includes LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, HubSpot, and Dreamdata, alongside AI-assisted tools for research, creative development, analysis, and automation.

You'll also have access to design, web, and RevOps support, as well as specialist external partners when they can add meaningful value.

You don't need experience with every tool. You do need to be comfortable evaluating new ones, building useful workflows, and working independently with performance data.

A little about working at Ashby

We're building software that helps recruiting teams do some of their most important work better. We care deeply about the quality of our product, the experience we create for customers, and the company we're building along the way.

We value thoughtful, ambitious people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and keep improving. We give people meaningful responsibility and expect them to exercise good judgment in how they use it.

We're deliberate about how we work. We believe strong teams can accomplish a lot without unnecessary process, layers of management, or endless meetings. We make time for considered thinking, direct feedback, and the kind of collaboration that makes the work better.

If that sounds like an environment where you'd do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Interview Plan

Our interview process is:

•
30 minutes intro call with Michelle (Recruiter Screen)

•
45 minutes interview with Harriet (Hiring Manager)

•
45 minutes interview with Sam (Paid Marketing Consultant)

•
Take-Home Assignment

•
Live Debrief to follow with Harriet and Sam

•
Final panel (1-1.5 hours)

Benefits

•
Competitive salary and equity.

•
Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.

•
10-year exercise window for stock options . You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

•
Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

•
Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

•
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

•
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

•
If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us and a 401k match.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities

•
Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques , incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

•
Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art , with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

•
Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

•
Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines , including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

•
Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

•
Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

•
Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content

Bonus Points

•
Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

•
Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

•
Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

•
Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

•
Experience with ComfyUI

•
Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth : From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech , led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies . We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!
