jobs.title: Senior GEO & SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
Influ2 brings ABM to the contact level. With Influ2, you can act on contact-level intent, reach specific buyers with ads, orchestrate journeys across channels, and make the revenue impact clear.

200+ enterprises and mid-market companies worldwide, including industry leaders such as Snowflake, AppsFlyer, and Capgemini, love our technology. We hope you will love it too.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a Senior SEO & GEO Specialist to own how buyers find, understand, and evaluate Influ2 through organic and AI search.

Buyers use AI tools alongside search engines, vendor content, and conversations to research solutions and compare options. We want Influ2 to provide accurate, useful information as buyers explore our category, evaluate alternatives, and build their shortlists.

The role is roughly 60% generative engine optimization and 40% traditional organic search. You will own the strategy, run experiments, and turn what you learn into action.

What you’ll do

• Grow AI search visibility. Understand the questions, topics, comparisons, alternatives, and use cases that matter to our buyers, and improve Influ2’s presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Build representative prompt sets and track brand mentions, descriptions, citations, cited sources, and competitors through repeated checks across platforms.

• Turn search demand into useful, cite-worthy content. Identify where we have content gaps and what needs to be created, updated, or restructured. Guide content and product marketing teams on clear definitions, comparisons, FAQs, original data, customer evidence, expert perspectives, and supporting sources. Set the standards and write the briefs; you will not be writing every post yourself.

• Build Influ2’s authority across the web. Understand which sources shape answers to our buyers’ questions and strengthen Influ2’s presence there. Audit how Influ2 and our category are described, correct inaccuracies, and earn relevant coverage across publications, analysts, partners, review sites, comparison content, and communities. Prioritize sources based on evidence from each platform and topic.

• Own technical discoverability across AI and search. Manage crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, rendering, Core Web Vitals, and structured data. Verify that search and AI crawlers can access the content we want surfaced through robots.txt, infrastructure settings, and logs, while managing model-training permissions separately.

• Own the SEO fundamentals. Identify organic search opportunities around the topics and queries that matter to our buyers. Improve and track rankings, impressions, clicks, organic traffic, and conversions, and turn performance data into priorities for content and technical improvements.

• Measure what works and separate meaningful gains from noise. Track AI share of voice, brand accuracy, mentions, citations, referral traffic, organic search performance, conversions, and pipeline. Form hypotheses, establish baselines, and repeat measurements before calling a result. Treat emerging tactics such as llms.txt as experiments, be clear about attribution limits, and scale what produces evidence of impact.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in SEO, with at least the past year focused on AI search visibility. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.

• Demonstrable GEO results. Be ready to explain your baseline, the prompts and platforms you tracked, what you changed, what happened, and how you assessed the results and their limitations.

• Strong technical SEO skills, including structured data, crawl and rendering behavior, log file analysis, site migrations, and Core Web Vitals.

• Fluency with Ahrefs or Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, and at least one AI visibility platform such as AthenaHQ, Brand Radar, Profound, Peec AI, or Otterly. Looker and SQL are a real plus.

• Digital PR and outreach experience, with a track record of earning relevant mentions, reviews, and coverage.

• A strong understanding of positioning and category development. You can connect unfamiliar concepts to the language buyers already use.

Skills

• Sound analytical judgment. You use data to make decisions and know how to move forward when the evidence is incomplete.

• Curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to adapt as search products and buyer behavior evolve.

• Comfort working independently, setting priorities, and seeing work through.

What’s in it for you

• Remote work, no fixed hours. Work wherever and whenever you do your best thinking.

• Unlimited vacation policy for your work-life balance.

• Generous parental leave and other thoughtful benefits.

• Well-rounded health package to keep you supported.

• A flat, fast-moving team where your ideas will have impact immediately.

We’ve raised a total of $15 million in our Series A round, maintaining a cash-positive business for the past 24 months while achieving 50% growth.

We're convinced that the diverse ideas and experiences every Influ2encer brings are the key to our success. To make sure our culture and products reflect this blend of viewpoints and backgrounds, there's no room for discrimination here. Our approach to hiring, training, promoting, and compensating individuals is grounded in merit and competence.

We're committed to offering equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, no matter their race, age, religion, where they come from, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Everyone at Influ2 plays a part in keeping our workplace welcoming and free from discrimination and harassment.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.title: Head of Marketing - Argentina / Uruguay
jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

About the role

We're searching for an exceptional marketing leader to grow Halter in Argentina and Uruguay - one of the biggest cattle regions in the world. You’ll be building recognition for Halter’s brand that reaches every farming community, with revenue performance to match. We're making our first moves on the ground and we need a senior leader to build the marketing foundation and be part of our core team.

This role is a key driver of full-funnel revenue performance: acquisition, expansion, and retention, all through marketing. You're not running events and content on instruction or directive from HQ. You are accountable for the local marketing strategy to achieve our revenue outcomes. That means thinking like a revenue owner first, and a marketer second.

Your job is to make sure marketing shows up as a genuine lever across that whole funnel: helping win new farmers, and also feeding the stories, proof points and community that keeps existing farmers expanding and retained. You, in tight collaboration with go-to-market leadership, will build this strategy, build the team to deliver against it, and own the demand and pipeline that drives Halter's growth for years to come.

We want you to own marketing for this region. You will have full support from Halter’s global marketing team based in New Zealand HQ, with the brand and strategic frameworks you need to do your job - think of this as our DNA and standardised thinking and that lets every region move fast without reinventing the wheel. We are building the feedback loop to take your feedback and wins, and globalise them, to make Halter’s marketing brilliant in all of our key markets. But ultimately the buck stops with you in Argentina and Uruguay - acquire, expand and retain the best farms in one of the best farming regions globally.

Who we are looking for:

•
A full-funnel revenue thinker, not a channel specialist. You've owned acquisition, expansion, and retention outcomes, not just top-of-funnel demand generation. You think in pipeline and revenue contribution first, achieved through strategically driving brand awareness

•
Deeply customer-led. You're energised by time on farm with cattle farmers, and you turn that firsthand understanding into commercial decisions such as messaging, proof points, and channel choices, not just generic content ideas.

•
A builder and world-class operator. You will build and lead a high-performing, efficient team, ideally with experience scaling a marketing or growth function in a fast paced environment. You will be comfortable rolling your sleeves up and playing ‘executor’, while also knowing the right time to give space to your team to win (or loose) and learn from that experience

•
Genuinely commercial. You’re not just comfortable being measured on a revenue number - you demand it from yourself and your team. You move fast on real bets, you’re allergic to decisions not backed by data, and you thrive on seeing real results in real time.

•
First-principles by instinct . You use Halter's global frameworks because they're smart, not because you're told to, and you know exactly when the local market demands something different, and can make that case with evidence, not opinion.

•
A strong operator across both brand and demand . You’re equally comfortable in a tone-of-voice conversation and a CAC/ROI conversation, and you’re able to move between the two with ease

•
Comfortable with ambiguity. You'd rather own the outcome and figure out the path than wait for a fully specified brief.

•
AI-forward as a default operating mode, not a tool you occasionally reach for. You and your team use AI to draft and iterate content, personalise outreach at a scale a human team couldn't match manually, and analyse campaign and funnel data faster than a traditional team would. You treat headcount as a last resort after you've pressure-tested what AI can already do, not the other way around.

What the role looks like:

•
Strategy & ownership: Own the marketing strategy and budget end to end, setting the vision and the plan to take Halter from early-market entry to category leadership and one of our largest revenue markets.

•
Organic growth & content. Build content that compounds: SEO-driven farmer resources, owned channels, and organic social that establishes Halter as the trusted voice in cattle, not just a paid acquisition function.

•
Events strategy. This sits at the heart of our territory manager regional model. You'll partner with sales leadership to decide which field days, expos, and farmer gatherings actually move pipeline in AU, and how they connect directly into the territory manager's patch and pipeline, not run as a separate marketing calendar.

•
Case studies & proof . Build a library of farmer stories and results that do double duty: acquisition proof points for new farmers, and expansion/retention proof points for existing ones.

•
Paid traffic. Work with the global Performance Marketing function running paid channels in-region with a sharp eye on customer acquisition costs (CAC) and pipeline contribution, not just reach or impressions.

•
Enterprise motion. Support and drive the enterprise/larger-account pipeline in AU specifically, where the buying committee, proof requirements, and sales cycle look different from owner-operator farms.

•
Accountability for the numbers: Own and report on pipeline, CAC, brand awareness and the complete revenue picture. Marketing is one of the most critical levers that sits right across the funnel, so it’s expected you will design the marketing strategy around each metric from acquisition through to net dollar retention.

•
Brand and tone of voice in-region. Use Halter's global brand as the foundation, and make the judgment calls on how it lands with Argentinian and Uruguayan farmers specifically: language, imagery, humour, what plays and what doesn't in this market.

•
Objection handling through stories, not just spec sheets. Build ROI case studies and compelling storytelling, delivered through the right channels at the right point in the funnel, that neutralise the objections AU farmers actually raise (price, proof, switching risk), not generic feature messaging.

Our Office First Approach:

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

Why our team loves working at Halter:

•
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

•
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

•
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

•
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We have multiple open roles for communications and storytelling (narrative development) specialists across social media and content production.
Canonical has a robust portfolio of open source products and offers support for a wide range of open source technologies. This role is for someone who cares deeply about narrative quality and wants to elevate our brand positioning. They would love to gain experience translating strategy into impact, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders. They enjoy learning and improving themselves, the team and the organization. They problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation and AI to make daily life easier. To succeed in this role, the candidate must be driven, organized and attentive to detail.

What your day will look like

• Passion for messaging quality and written communication.

• An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.

• Business level written and spoken English.

• Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.

• International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

• 2-7 years of experience in a relevant field

Nice-to-have skills

• Applied knowledge of AEO/GEO and SEO

• Experience in B2B technology marketing, communications or related fields

• Experience developing content marketing or communications strategies for enterprise technology products

• Experience with project management tools like Jira

What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

💰Annual compensation review
🏆Recognition rewards
🏝 Annual holiday leave
👶Parental Leave
🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

About PropertyTek
PropertyTek is a private equity-backed holding company transforming property management through a growing portfolio of SaaS brands. Our products power leasing automation for single- and multifamily residential property managers.

We're looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. This is a role that will build the systems that move leads through our marketing funnel, directly supporting Sales and our mission to transform the property technology landscape.

Role Overview
We're hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to own HubSpot workflow architecture across our property management SaaS portfolio (ShowMojo and Tenant Turner). This is not an execution-only role: the person in this seat designs and builds the automation logic that drives lifecycle marketing, not just runs pre-built workflows.

This is a contractor position, remote, Philippines-based preferred.

Key Responsibilities
Workflow Architecture

• Design and build multi-branch HubSpot workflows from scratch, not just editing existing sequences

• Architect lead scoring models tailored to property management buyer behavior

• Build segmentation logic specific to the property management vertical (portfolio size, unit count, market, product line — ShowMojo vs. Tenant Turner)

• Design lifecycle-stage email flows: lead nurture, trial/onboarding, activation, upsell/expansion, renewal, win-back

Hubspot Execution

Content & Landing Pages

• Write email copy for automated email workflows sequences

• Build and publish landing pages in HubSpot's CMS/page tools to support campaigns and lifecycle flows

• Publish blog posts and pages in WordPress

• Ensure workflows, content, and landing pages work as one connected system

Ongoing Optimization

• Run and maintain our lead nurture flows: keep emails, offers, and links current, and test changes that improve engagement and conversions

• Monitor email performance and revise logic accordingly; share the results and make regular optimization recommendations to the team

• Maintain clean data hygiene practices within workflows (list membership, enrollment/re-enrollment logic, suppression rules)

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated HubSpot workflow architecture experience — must be able to design multi-branch automation from a blank canvas, not just configure templates

• Hands-on experience building lead scoring models

• Experience building segmentation strategies (behavioral, firmographic, or lifecycle-based)

• Experience designing lifecycle-stage email flows (nurture through renewal)

• Experience building landing pages in HubSpot's CMS or page builder tools

• Hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: building emails, landing pages, and campaigns

• 3+ years in marketing automation, ideally with at least 1–2 years focused specifically on HubSpot

• Strong B2B email copywriting skills, with samples you can share

• Experience publishing content in WordPress

• A sharp eye for QA: you catch broken links, wrong personalization tokens, and rendering issues before anything goes out

• Comfortable reading email performance data (opens, clicks, conversions) and turning it into clear recommendations

• Organized and proactive, with the communication skills to keep multiple teams aligned on a shared calendar

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous, US-hours-adjacent environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in property management, real estate, or a related vertical (rental software, PropTech, or landlord/tenant-facing products)

• HubSpot certification(s) — Marketing Software, Email Marketing, or Reporting

• Experience working across multiple product lines or brands within one HubSpot portal

• Experience with A/B testing email sequences and using results to refine workflow logic

• Experience running or maintaining lead nurture and lifecycle email flows

• Experience with UTM tracking and campaign attribution

Schedule and Availability
This role is a full-time equivalent of about 160 hours a month. Your working day should overlap consistently with US Eastern morning hours, when our standups, Sales syncs, and most async requests happen.

Rate starts at $15 per hour

jobs.title: Staff Web Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-First by Default

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

Staff Web Engineer Marketing

About the role

Deepgram builds foundational voice AI and deepgram.com is where the world meets it. The site is our digital front door, showcasing our products, brand moments, and pricing information, and it drives the company's self-serve revenue.

We're hiring a Staff Web Engineer to own the site's code for the long haul. Deepgram.com is entering its next chapter. We are fully refreshing the experience top to bottom. You'll be the person who knows the site inside out. You'll own the repo, the architecture, the Sanity environments, and the QA bar — and act as the code-review gate for day-to-day page and content work. The team is small but scaling. You will be working on the Web team reporting into the Head of Brand & Awareness and closely collaborating with our Senior Web Manager, product, marketing, sales, and external development partners.

Most critically, as an AI company, you must be AI-native. Agents and AI tooling are your go-to in how you choose to build, review, and QA. We are aiming to build a machine-first, voice-first site experience. It’s an exciting time to join the web team.

What you'll do

•
Own the deepgram.com codebase end to end — the Next.js application (front and back end), the GitHub repo, branching and CI/CD, and code review

•
Optimize and maintain Sanity CMS architecture — schemas, the reusable module library, the staging and production environments and publishing workflow

•
Run the global design system , component library, Vercel platform and spearhead AI integrations. Experienced with global CSS systems.

•
Build and run the site's QA program — starting with a well-structured and scalable staging environment that keeps a marketing site launch-ready at all times

•
Lead internationalization and localization efforts — language-locale URL and routing architecture, hreflang, and the path from i18n plumbing to localized (l10n) content

•
Assist in technical SEO — site architecture, redirects, Core Web Vitals — with on-page SEO executed by content partners inside your review gate

•
Ensure LLM discoverability (AEO) — the site's structured data, metadata, and content architecture must serve answer engines as well as people

•
Technical infrastructure for experimentation — develop the mechanisms to support the site's experimentation program

•
Marketing Ops partnership — implementation of forms, gated content, and attribution instrumentation (GTM, GA4, HubSpot)

•
Cybersecurity posture — maintain security and run routine safety audits across dependencies and scripts

•
High-velocity shipping — ship complex site improvements and launch campaign pages in a product-driven atmosphere

•
AI-native workflow — use agents in your daily build process and create tooling for safe marketing publishing

We are looking for candidates with:

•
Marketing web development background — ownership of marketing sites, not just product surfaces

•
Enterprise repository ownership : branching strategy, CI/CD, and a strong code-review culture

•
Headless CMS architecture — Next.js with Sanity strongly preferred

•
Modern React ecosystem for the web

•
Vercel as a production platform

•
AI-native development — ability to demonstrate concrete use of AI agents and tooling in your workflow

•
High level of ownership & accountability — a hand raiser who’s ready to join an ambitious team and company

•
Technical leadership — directing or reviewing the work of agency developers

Our ideal candidates also have:

•
Prior experience with internationalization (i18n/l10n) : URL architecture, locale routing, and multi-region infrastructure

•
Familiarity with A/B testing on production marketing sites

•
Interest in voice AI and the future of voice-interactive web experiences

Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Content & Communications Intern
jobs.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

Ready to Make an Impact?

jobs.title: Freelance SEO Content Writer - Spanish
jobs.description:
Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.

This is a fully remote freelance opportunity and is open to candidates located anywhere in Spain.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Brafton is looking for a freelance Spanish language writer with strong SEO knowledge. B2B insurance and/or finance subject matter expertise is a big plus. Strong enough English language skills are required to collaborate with coworkers in the UK and US.

The writer will produce strong, creative, and industry-specific pieces that are incorporated into content marketing campaigns for Brafton's clients.

This is an ongoing freelance opportunity involving keyword research, translations, localization, and writing.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Research, create, revise, and deliver high-quality content to clients according to specified deadlines.

• Work with Project Managers and Content Marketing Strategists to ensure our clients’ expectations and goals are met.

• Conduct keyword research and SEO briefs.

• Translate existing copy from English to Spanish.

• Apply localization to translations.

• Track writing and editing production work on a weekly basis using our in-house project management system.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

• 1-3 years of professional Spanish writing experience.

• A related university degree.

• Experience with SEO keyword research.

• Excellent writing and editing skills with an extreme attention to detail.

• Comprehensive understanding of SEO and best practices for branded writing.

• Strong, efficient research abilities and the ability to quickly learn, understand, and write about complex subjects.

• Excellent time management and organizational skills, with a desire to work in a fast-paced, high-volume, deadline-oriented environment.

• A creative approach to client briefs and content marketing goals.

• A self-starter with the ability to work independently and in collaboration with other team members in a fully remote environment.

• Knowledge of AP (Associated Press) Style is a plus.

Compensation

Additional Information

As a full-service agency, we offer strategy, branding, website design, development, copywriting, and performance marketing solutions. At Anchour, we believe in cultivating an inclusive environment where creativity, curiosity, and collaboration thrive.

What You’ll Do

Bring Motion to Life : Add animation and motion to ads and creative assets, leveraging tools like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and After Effects to bring dynamic ideas to life.

Experiment & Innovate : Test new concepts, visual styles, and creative approaches to discover what resonates with audiences and drives results.

Present & Refine Designs : Confidently share your creative work with clients, articulate your thinking, and incorporate feedback to deliver polished final assets.

Manage Your Workflow: Stay organized and manage your time effectively to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Stay Ahead of Trends: Keep up with design and platform trends, exploring new creative ideas that elevate our work and push boundaries.

What We’d Like To See

• Proven Expertise: 3+ years of experience in a design role focused on Meta ads, email marketing, or performance-driven campaigns, preferably in an agency or for high-performing brands.

• Figma Mastery: Extensive experience designing in Figma, including creating templates, prototypes, and layouts for both ads and emails.

• CapCut Proficiency: Familiarity with CapCut to create and refine light animations for Meta ads and short-form digital content.

• Strong Adobe Skills: Working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects for secondary design tasks.

• Email Expertise: A strong understanding of email marketing best practices, responsive design principles, and user-centric layouts.

• Meta Advertising Know-How: Deep familiarity with Meta ad formats, specs, and design best practices for performance marketing.

• Portfolio of Results-Driven Work: A portfolio showcasing your ability to create engaging digital designs that meet campaign objectives and drive results.

• Detail-Oriented & Strategic: A keen eye for detail, typography, composition, and hierarchy, paired with the ability to think strategically about design’s role in achieving performance goals.

• Adaptable & Curious: A growth-oriented mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, trends, and techniques.

• Team Player: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, working seamlessly with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to bring ideas to life.

What You’ll Get

• Competitive Salary.

• Work remotely. Live and work wherever you like.

• Retirement. Savings plan with a 4% company match.

• Premium Insurance. Premium health, dental, vision, and life insurance with generous coverage for our US-based team members.

• Optional HSA. An optional health savings account (HSA) for employees to set aside money on a pre-tax basis for medical expenses.

• Home Office Setup. Get a laptop + 50% reimbursement for home office equipment.

• Paid & Flexible Holidays. 12 paid holidays throughout the year, including three flexible holidays.

• Paid Time Off. Minimum three weeks of paid time off per year.

• Paid Leaves. Paid parental, medical, bereavement, and other types of leave.

• Flexible & Summer Fridays. Half-day Fridays throughout the summer, and a get-it-done-and-go mindset year-round.

• Lifelong Learners Fund. Cash for professional development (books, conferences, courses), and team bonding fun times.

• Baby Bonding Bucks. $500 bonus to cover diapers, meals, or other baby-related expenses for any employee welcoming a new child

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Marketing Automation - CANADA
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own a core part of how our clients market themselves: the websites, content, and campaigns that get them found, keep them top of mind, and turn attention into business. Our clients are real estate professionals, many of them top producers in luxury markets, and they count on us for the marketing they don't have time to do themselves.

Generating marketing content is easy now. Generating content a top agent is proud to put their name on is not. That bar, across every channel our clients use, is the game we're in. So is proving what works: showing clients how their channels feed each other and which ones are actually driving business.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with close collaboration across engineering, design, AI/ML, client success, and sales. You'll own a product area end to end, set its strategy, and grow its scope as we expand into new channels.

What You'll Do

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for a set of AI-powered marketing products, starting with how our clients get discovered and the content we create for them

• Make sure our clients get found, whether a prospective buyer or seller searches on Google or asks an AI assistant who to call

• Raise the quality bar on everything we create on our clients' behalf, so it sounds like them and reflects the brand they've built

• Design how channels work together, so a client's website, content, email, and social reinforce each other instead of running as separate tools

• Build the measurement and attribution that show clients, and us, how those channels drive each other and which ones are actually producing business

• Run structured betas with real clients, set clear hypotheses up front, and keep iterating until clients would be upset to lose what you've built

• Build the business case for your roadmap and tie it to adoption, retention, and revenue

• Ship with your own engineering and design partners, and work closely with client success and sales so launches land

Who You Are

• 7+ years of product management, including owning a product line end to end where you were accountable for adoption, outcomes, and revenue

• Marketing taste. You can tell great marketing from generic, and you know how a premium brand should and shouldn't show up. You'd catch the post that makes a client look bad before it ships

• Multichannel instincts. You understand how search, content, email, social, and paid work together as a system, and you want to see the numbers move across all of them, not just one

• Experience building marketing technology: products businesses use to grow their own customer base

• Solid SEO fundamentals, and a view of discovery that goes beyond the website to reviews, social, and what people say about a business across the web

• You run your area like a business. You build the case before you build the product, and you own the result

• Close to your customers. You talk to them often and can explain why something matters in their terms

• You create momentum in ambiguity. You narrow the problem, make a call, and move before every question is answered

• A communicator who can get a room excited, from engineers to executives to client success, and who earns trust across teams you don't manage

• You learn fast and use AI as a normal part of how you work: to research, to prototype, and to get to ground truth quickly

Preferred Qualifications

• Product experience at a company serving small businesses or solo operators who judge you on results, such as Shopify, Squarespace, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Square, or Yelp

• You've built email, lifecycle, or campaign tools, or products that generate marketing content with AI

• Hands-on experience with marketing analytics or attribution products

• Familiarity with premium or luxury brands and how they market differently

• Experience at a platform where one change reaches many customers' sites or accounts at once

• A background in content, editorial, or brand work

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

jobs.title: SEO & AEO Manager
jobs.description:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

Sitting within Corporate Marketing, the SEO & AEO Manager owns Juniper Square's visibility across organic search, AEO, and GEO: how we're found, ranked, and cited, in traditional search and in the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) that GPs and fund operations teams increasingly use to research vendors and ideas. Working across the broader GTM organization, you'll set the strategy, then own execution end to end, from technical foundation to AI visibility to authority building.

GPs come to Juniper Square for software, for fund administration services, or increasingly both, and each entry point carries its own nuance (terminology, competitive set, audience expectations, etc.) so your strategy has to flex across the full platform rather than run one generic playbook. AEO and GEO add another layer: there's no industry-established playbook yet, and you're expected to help write one for Juniper Square rather than just execute someone else's. The right candidate uses AI as standard infrastructure and pairs technical rigor with the discipline to build processes that compound over time.

The application deadline for this role is October 5th, 2026.

What you’ll do

Own Technical SEO
Success here means organic traffic and rankings grow measurably against a defined set of priority terms across Juniper Square's full platform.

•
Own SEO across junipersquare.com : on-page optimization, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and regular technical audits, partnering with our web engineering agency to scope and ship fixes.

•
Monitor and improve sitewide crawl efficiency and indexing. Manage structured data (JSON-LD) and emerging AI crawling protocols, including llms.txt and plain-text/markdown alternates of priority pages.

•
Own the brief and quality bar for agency and vendor relationships across SEO, AEO, and content production, deciding what stays in-house.

•
Monitor Juniper Square's rankings against named competitors, in both traditional search and AI answer engines. When a competitor overtakes us on a priority term, diagnose why and drive the fix, whether that's a technical change, a content update, or an authority play.

Win Citations Across the Open Web

Success here means Juniper Square gets cited by name in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews for the private markets questions that matter, tracked against named competitors.

•
Optimize content for LLM and AI-search visibility: schema and structured data, answer-first formatting, and semantic reinforcement that makes Juniper Square content easy for AI systems to extract and cite.

•
Extend that visibility beyond junipersquare.com to Reddit threads, YouTube (titles, descriptions, chapters, and metadata built to rank in video results), review sites, and other community content LLMs treat as trusted sources, and direct that content to work for two readers at once, crawlers and humans, using AI-assisted workflows to scale production without lowering the quality bar.

•
Contribute to the broader social content strategy, including LinkedIn, so format and structure support search and AI-citation goals across channels, not just engagement.

•
Run controlled experiments to isolate what actually moves AI citations rather than treating AEO as guesswork, and turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook.

•
Track how AI platforms retrieve, summarize, and attribute Juniper Square content, report regularly on citation share alongside organic traffic and rankings, and use that data to reprioritize the roadmap.

•
Treat technical SEO and GEO as one program with shared priorities instead of running them as separate workstreams.

Build Category Authority

Success here means referring domains and citations from private markets and financial media keep growing: real evidence Juniper Square is gaining authority on private markets ideas, not just its own product terms.

•
Build Juniper Square's authority on the ideas that define private markets, not just on product and brand terms, so we're the source search engines and AI systems point to on GP operations, fund administration, and other core private markets topics.

•
Tailor authority-building work to how a GP is engaging us, whether that's software, fund administration, or both, since the competitors and publications that matter shift with the entry point.

•
Partner with content and subject-matter experts to identify where Juniper Square should be the definitive answer to a private markets question but isn't yet, and close those gaps.

Qualifications

•
5+ years in SEO, including hands-on ownership of a technical SEO program at a large B2B organization.

•
Real, hands-on AEO/GEO experience, not just familiarity with the concept. You should be able to point to a specific citation you've earned in an AI answer engine and explain exactly how you did it.

•
A track record of earning backlinks and media citations built on original research or data, not outreach templates alone.

•
Experience with SEO/GEO tooling, including rank trackers, log-file analysis, and AI-citation monitoring platforms. Plus hands-on experience with AEO/GEO or AI-citation monitoring tools, such as Profound, Airops, etc.

•
Enough technical fluency with structured data and schema markup (JSON-LD) to spec work precisely and partner directly with engineers on implementation.

•
Strong writing and editorial judgment: this role often means shaping how a piece of content is framed and structured, not just tagging it after the fact.

•
Comfort operating with real ambiguity. AEO/GEO best practices are still being defined industry-wide, and this role is as much about building Juniper Square's playbook as running it.

•
Experience optimizing social media and video content for search.

•
Experience in financial services, fintech, or private markets, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly on a technical, regulated industry.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary of $116,000 - $160,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

•
Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

•
Life insurance

•
Mental wellness coverage

•
Fertility and growing family support

•
Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

•
Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

•
Retirement saving plans

•
Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

•
Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

jobs.title: Editorial Content Specialist (SEO & AEO)
jobs.description:
For the curious writers and search obsessed.

You know that feeling when you search for something and find an article that actually answers your question, no robotic filler, no keyword stuffing, just great taste and genuine utility? That’s the exact energy we care about.

We’re looking for an Editorial Content Specialist who loves the sweet spot where storytelling meets search intelligence. Someone who crafts pieces creative pros actually want to read, while understanding how modern search and answer engines discover and surface that work.

A little about us

Envato is an all-in-one creative toolkit, bringing together world-class creative assets and purpose-built AI tools to help people make their ideas real.

Our community is made up of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who care about craft, love experimenting and are always looking for the next tool, technique or spark of inspiration to make better work.

What’s the gig?

You’ll be creating and editing tutorials, guides, and articles that solve real problems for creative pros. You’ll be digging into search trends and AI search behaviours to find untapped content gaps, producing fresh pieces that rank in traditional search and get cited in AI answer overviews.

You’ll be using generative AI daily to speed up your ideation and drafting, always backing it up with your sharp editorial eye so everything sounds human, clear, and on-brand.

You’ll also be publishing directly in WordPress, curating visuals from Envato, optimising internal links, and checking performance data to iterate on what works best alongside our Search Visibility team and external contributors.

Sound like you?

You have 5+ years of experience in writing, content marketing, or editorial roles, ideally within creative tools or tech. You know organic search inside out and already understand how answer engine optimization (AEO) and AI summaries work.

Generative AI is a natural part of your daily creative workflow, you’re confident managing content in WordPress, and you communicate fluently in both English and Spanish. Most of all, you bring strong editorial judgement and take pride in work that real humans enjoy reading.

Show us what you’ve got

Send us 2–3 writing samples or live links you’re proud of that showcase your editorial tone, storytelling skills, and how you explain creative concepts clearly.

Life at Envato

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

Our benefits in Mexico include 30 days of Christmas bonus pay, 12 days of vacation in your first year, a 100% vacation bonus, monthly grocery vouchers, a 5% savings fund, private health insurance, home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year, plus our Conoce México benefit to help you explore more of Mexico.

A few things before you apply

We embrace diversity at Envato and want to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy . We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

Ecommerce and Digital Marketing Manager

ACE STAINLESS SUPPLY

Full-time | Fully remote | Worldwide
$10,000–$25,000 USD annually, depending on experience
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM Pacific Time

Build a website that earns its place in the business

Help us turn a ready product catalog into a working carbon steel storefront—and turn our digital marketing into qualified inquiries, orders, and repeat customers.

ACE Stainless Supply distributes stainless steel pipe, valves, fittings, bar, and sheet, serving customers through our Santa Ana, California, and Caldwell, Idaho, operations. We are expanding our digital business with AceCarbonSteel.com, and we want someone who can help build it, launch it, and grow it.

You will report to Erica Biscocho, Director of E-Commerce and Digital Operations. You will work alongside Hafsa in e-commerce and our marketing team, coordinate product information with Funmi, and partner with sales and our technical providers. This is a hands-on role: you will create content, make website improvements, run campaigns, and move launch work through to completion.

Your first major deliverable

Launch design of AceCarbonSteel.com as an operational customer-facing website on January 1, 2027.

Our clean product data is ready. Your work is to transfer it accurately, propose the branding and design, build the shopping experience with the team, and prove that customers can use it successfully. You must bring practical website implementation experience as well as marketing skills.

The January 1 launch takes priority within your first 90 days. Our accelerated launch milestones are:

By November 20, 2026 — Present branding and design proposals for Erica’s approval: visual direction, homepage, category and product page concepts, navigation, mobile layouts, and a dated implementation plan with owners and dependencies.

By December 15, 2026 — Complete the approved design and catalog migration in staging. Configure search, filters, product pages, quote and purchase paths, and measurement tools with the appropriate team members.

By December 30, 2026 — Complete testing and corrections. Submit a documented launch checklist, test results, and outstanding issues for Erica’s go-live approval.

January 1, 2027 — Launch the approved site with working customer journeys, verified inquiry and order routing, and a launch campaign ready to run.

Through the remainder of your first 90 days, monitor the live site, resolve issues, and use actual customer behavior and sales results to prioritize improvements.

What launch ready means

You will own the launch checklist and coordinate technical dependencies early. Before release, the team must verify:

Catalog accuracy: reconcile source and destination record counts; validate product identifiers, descriptions, sizes, materials, units of measure, weights, categories, and approved pricing. Resolve discrepancies with Funmi before publishing.

Customer experience: test navigation, product search and filters, mobile layouts, images, downloads, account access where applicable, and clear paths to request a quote or place an order.

Transactions and handoffs: test quote forms and notifications; validate applicable cart, checkout, payment, tax, freight, and order-confirmation flows with the responsible providers. Confirm that inquiries and orders reach the right Ace team.

Search and measurement: verify page titles, metadata, crawl and indexing settings, sitemap, redirects where needed, and analytics events for product views, inquiries, and purchases. Confirm that staging restrictions are removed at launch.

Operations: document how the team maintains the site, manages incoming inquiries and orders, and reports defects. Complete Erica’s final review before going live.

What you will own after launch

SEO and website conversion

Build keyword and competitor research around how contractors, fabricators, and purchasing teams actually search. Improve category pages, product pages, metadata, internal links, and useful educational content. Use Google Search Console to identify indexing and search issues; use GA4 to find where customers abandon inquiry or purchase paths. Maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and complete approved changes.

Social media and content

Own a practical publishing calendar for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Create product features, application explainers, branch updates, customer stories with permission, and promotional content. Produce two YouTube videos per month and repurpose them into shorter clips and posts. Coordinate original footage with branch staff and verify technical claims with the product team.

Email and sales support

Build and execute two Mailchimp campaigns each week, on Monday and Thursday. Segment audiences, maintain contact lists, test links and mobile layouts, and direct customers to relevant products or quote forms. Keep line cards, branch marketing materials, and website promotions current. Work with sales to connect campaign inquiries to follow-up and results.

Brand consistency and execution

Keep messaging, visuals, product information, and calls to action consistent across websites, email, and social channels. Bring concepts and recommendations to Erica, obtain required approvals, and carry approved work through publication. Maintain a shared task board with deadlines, owners, blockers, and next actions.

How we will measure success

Send a concise performance report every Monday by 10:00 AM Pacific Time. Show what changed, what it produced, and what you will do next. Establish baselines and agree on numeric growth targets with Erica during onboarding.

Website revenue and orders by site, with campaign attribution where tracking supports it.

Qualified web inquiries and quote requests; quote-to-order conversion in partnership with sales.

Organic search clicks, relevant search visibility, and progress on indexing or technical issues.

Conversion rates and customer drop-off across product, inquiry, and purchase journeys.

Email clicks, qualified inquiries, and attributable sales; social engagement and referral traffic as supporting measures.

Launch milestones, completed improvements, unresolved blockers, and the next week’s priorities.

Pricing follows Ace’s approved matrix and management direction. You will improve how we present and sell products, coordinating pricing or source-data changes with the people responsible for them.

What you should bring

Examples of websites or e-commerce projects you helped launch, including your actual role in catalog migration, page setup, testing, and release.

Proven SEO and digital marketing work with results you can explain: starting point, actions, timeframe, and business impact.

Hands-on ability in website content management, GA4, Google Search Console, Mailchimp or a comparable platform, and SEO research tools.

Strong written English, visual design judgment, and the ability to create useful graphics and edit video.

Comfort working with structured product data and spreadsheets while protecting specifications, units of measure, and approved pricing.

Clear remote communication, dependable availability during the stated Pacific Time schedule, and the ability to organize several workstreams.

Practical use of AI tools, with human review for product accuracy, brand quality, and original thinking.

Experience with B2B distribution, industrial products, Shopify, ERP-connected storefronts, or INxSQL is a plus. You can learn our products; you should arrive knowing how to execute digital work and demonstrate results.

Why this opportunity

You will work directly with the leader responsible for digital growth, have a prepared catalog to build from, and see your work become a live sales channel. We value people who spot opportunities, propose a solution, follow through, and are candid when something needs attention.

How to apply

Email your résumé and portfolio to tom@acestainless.com with the subject line: ACE Digital Marketing and Ecommerce — Erica will help review candidates and assess the working fit. Erica will be your direct report.

Please include:

Two relevant examples of your work, describing what you personally built or managed and the results.

A short note with three specific opportunities you see for AceStainless.com or the AceCarbonSteel.com launch. Brief bullets are enough.

A brief outline of how you would approach the January 1 launch, including the support you would need and any timing risks.

Your location, earliest start date, and confirmation that you can work the stated Pacific Time schedule.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ace-stainless-supply-social-media-seo-manager-2

The Role: We are hiring a Marketing Specialist to work across both client and Forward Push marketing priorities, taking approved strategy, content, and direction and turning it into accurate, polished work that is executed correctly. That includes creating brand and web assets from approved direction.

This is a hands-on, proactive role. Our AI agents and automations handle more of the repetitive work every month, so this role is not about copying and pasting or scheduling posts. In your first few months you will also handle hands-on execution, such as publishing, onboarding, and QA. As we automate those tasks, your role grows toward strategy and ideas.

We do not expect you to know everything. We do expect you to know how to find the answer, test what you learn, document it, and know when a question is needed before moving forward.

This is not an entry-level marketing position. We are looking for someone with enough experience to know what good marketing execution looks like and enough judgment to catch problems before they become rework. You'll co-own upmarket pipeline with Sales, partner with Product on the self-serve-to-enterprise conversion motion, and partner with our in-house Growth/Paid team and RevOps to make sure the whole system is instrumented and accountable.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Pipeline Strategy & Execution

You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.

You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.

jobs.title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative , a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

• Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.

• Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.

• Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.

• Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.

• Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.

• Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.

What you’ll bring

• Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.

• Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

What success looks like

A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. The Team + The Role

Pendo's Product Marketing team translates what we build into why it matters. The team works at the intersection of product, revenue, and marketing, owning the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that drive pipeline and commercial outcomes. It operates as a small, senior team with high ownership, low overhead, and a strong bias toward work that moves the business forward.

Pendo is looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to play a key role in our growing Enterprise business. You will partner closely across Product, Sales, and Marketing to package and position Pendo's offerings as powerful solutions for Enterprise clients. This is an individual contributor role for a builder who can create, test, adapt, and make an immediate impact in a fast-moving, AI-native environment.

This is a remote role in the United States. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

• Enterprise positioning: Own and maintain clear, concise, and impactful solutions messaging for the Enterprise market. Translate Pendo's product capabilities into value-driven narratives that resonate with Enterprise buyers.

• Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate strategically with Product, PMM, Sales, and Marketing teams to package and position Pendo's offerings for Enterprise clients. Serve as a key conduit between Enterprise go-to-market teams and Product by bringing field feedback into product conversations.

• Flexible execution: Move fluidly across adjacent work as priorities shift, including solutions marketing, growth-hacker-style experiments, and demand-gen support. Adapt quickly rather than staying in a single fixed lane.

• AI-enabled GTM: Leverage AI tools and workflows, including building agents, to accelerate research, content creation, and go-to-market execution. Use AI as a practical multiplier for how you work and what you ship.

• Market research: Conduct in-depth research to define, understand, and articulate the distinct needs and opportunities within the Enterprise landscape for Pendo. Use that insight to shape messaging, campaign direction, and sales conversations.

• Sales partnership: Forge strong partnerships with the Enterprise Sales team to understand their requirements, challenges, and revenue opportunities. Participate in strategic Enterprise deals by providing product and solutions expertise.

• Testing and iteration: Rapidly test, learn, and adapt messaging and campaigns in a fast-changing environment. Use feedback from the market, Sales, and Product to improve the work quickly.

• Enterprise content: Develop compelling content and collateral for Enterprise audiences, including presentations, white papers, and case studies. Ensure materials are clear, persuasive, and aligned to the needs of Enterprise buyers.

• Enterprise strategy support: Elevate and accelerate Pendo's overall Enterprise marketing strategy and execution. Contribute strategically to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, and enablement programs tailored for the Enterprise market.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. Product Marketing Managers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

• A proven track record of building and shipping product marketing work, with depth of ownership that matters more than the number of years in seat.

• Experience creating, testing, and adapting product marketing work in fast-moving, high-growth, startup, or similarly ambiguous environments.

• AI fluency, including comfort working in an AI-shaped environment and using AI tools or workflows to improve research, content creation, and execution.

• Ability to operate in ambiguity, move across shifting priorities, and flex into adjacent areas such as solutions marketing, growth, and demand generation.

• Exceptional ability to translate technical product features into compelling, value-driven solutions for buyers.

• Demonstrated experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and developing targeted messaging.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Product, Sales, and Marketing teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.

• Experience supporting Enterprise marketing, Enterprise sales motions, or strategic Enterprise deals.

• Experience developing Enterprise-facing collateral such as presentations, white papers, and case studies.

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.
